title: Chapter 55 — Showroom Events and The Designer Evening
intro: Turning your floor into a BD engine.

sections.title: Events as Business Development
sections.content:
Hosting events for designers, builders, and contractors in your showroom positions you as a resource, not just a retailer. Product launches, brand presentations, cooking demonstrations, and continuing education sessions all create reasons for trade professionals to visit your floor.

Every attendee is a potential account. The event is the introduction. The follow-up is the business development.

sections.title: Coaching Rule
sections.content:
When evaluating events, ask:

Is the store hosting trade-focused events — or only consumer promotions?
Are events followed up with structured outreach — or forgotten after the evening?
Are events generating new trade relationships?
